title: Depth and normals (MoGe 3)
description: Fine-detail depth and normal maps from one image (MoGe 3): material maps, relighting, normal-map starts for props and terrain. Pick the map with `output`: normal_opengl (default; Unity, Blender, glTF), normal_directx (Unreal), depth, depth_colored or mask (silhouette only).

output.description: Which map to return. normal_opengl: green = up (Unity, Blender, glTF); normal_directx: green = down (Unreal); depth: grey depth; depth_colored: colour-coded depth; mask: white silhouette.
